commands.help: Lists files and directories in a target path, with optional recursive listing.
commands.long_help: Lists directory contents including file sizes and modification times. Supports local paths, drive letters (C:), UNC paths (\\server\share), and wildcards. Output shows date/time, size (or <dir>/<junction>), and filename. Displays total file size and counts at the end. When omitted, lists the current directory.

arguments.name: targetdir
arguments.desc: Directory or file path to list. Supports UNC paths (\\server\share) and wildcards. Default: current directory.
